voiceSummary: Denta Water and Infra Solutions Limited submitted newspaper advertisements for its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 06, 2026. The company published the notice in Financial Express and Vishwavani on November 07, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the standalone total income was 5068.54 million rupees, with a profit for the period of 509.14 million rupees. Earnings per share were 4.45 rupees basic and 4.42 rupees diluted. The consolidated net profit for the quarter was 131.47 million rupees. Ajax Engineering Limited also approved its unaudited financial results for the same period on November 06, 2026. Its standalone total income for the quarter was 268.88 million rupees, with a profit of 50.91 million rupees. Trejhara Solutions Limited reported unaudited consolidated results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, showing total income of 7,795.18 lakhs and net profit after tax of 460.90 lakhs.
